name: Diya Jose
tagline: Full-stack developer · Java, Python and SQL
about:
Hi, I'm Diya, a Computer Science graduate (B.Tech, KTU, 2025) from Kerala who enjoys building full-stack applications, mostly with Java, Python and SQL.

I like working close to the data: designing database schemas, writing queries that stay fast, and connecting them to clean, easy-to-use interfaces. As a fresher, I'm eager to learn, take on real-world problems, and grow alongside an experienced team.
seoDescription: Diya Jose, full-stack developer from Kerala working with Java, Python and SQL. Projects, education and contact.
